detail.longDescription: Lonely Things Things get lonely only when you die: yes, I noticed Things bleed superficially, because they’re made of plastic, polymer, and copper tubes. Crystal skin, bones are vapor thin; no marrow, sinew, dewy eyes or thighs, as Things just wear a silicon disguise. Things lie happily, eating your tender spirit dry, sucking your sanity out of your nose, dining on the hope and love in your blood, hemorrhaged from a battered skull, your beautiful dreams spill from a empty hull bereft of will and any- Thing resembling human dignity. #Artifice #ArtificialIntelligence #Humanity #Simulacrum #Soul #Spirituality
